about: Editor spec §51, spec_secrets_and_fences (GS4): the shapes of secret a reader refuses, each found by its shape and named in words, never by the text that matched. packages/graph-spec/test/serving.test.mjs and python/graph_spec/tests/test_serving_fences.py hold both libraries to this table. A text holding a secret's shape is written as a list of pieces, joined with nothing between them, so this file itself holds no secret's shape.

cases.text: The password policy is in the handbook
